advisor_identified: Historian of Vietnam and Southeast Asia, Department of History, University of Ottawa.

doctorate.title: Tradition for Rebellion: Vietnamese Students and Teachers and Anticolonial Resistance, 1888-1931

evidence.says: Author note, p. 22, identifies Micheline Lessard as professor of Southeast Asian and Vietnamese history at the University of Ottawa and states that she obtained a PhD from Cornell University in 1995.

Women in Southeast Asian Nationalist Movements (NUS Press, 2013), Contributors, p. 317: identifies Lessard as a University of Ottawa history professor specializing in Southeast Asia and states that she received a PhD in Southeast Asian history at Cornell University in 1995.

Cindy Anh Nguyen, Bibliotactics (University of California Press, 2026), bibliography, p. 275, cites Micheline Lessard, Tradition for Rebellion: Vietnamese Students and Teachers and Anti-colonial Resistance, 1888–1931, as a Cornell University PhD dissertation, 1995.

notes: Institution, year, author, and title agree with linked AHA record 35947. Title corroboration is from a scholarly bibliography; a thesis catalogue record was not retrieved. The journal author note and bibliography were available through indexed source text.
